newsitem.title: POLAND: BWR raises stake in Secesyjny to 40.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: BWR raises stake in Secesyjny to 40.2 pct.

text.p: Poland's Bank Wspolpracy Regionalnej (BWR) increased its stake in Bank Secesyjny SA, which it plans to take over by mid-1997, to 40.15 percent by taking 32,500 new shares, BWR said in a statement on Thursday.
Before taking the shares BWR had 31.59 percent of the shares in Secesyjny.
It said the 40.15-percent stake gives it 48.1 percent of votes on the general shareholders' meeting.
It said it had taken 30,000 registered, preferred shares and 2,500 common shares of Secesyjny's December issue.
Other shareholders of Secesyjny include the Katowice steel mill, a coal trading agency as well as other steel mill and coal agencies.
